detail.longDescription: When you have a pile of similar work, the instinct is to go as fast as you can. I don't think speed is the right goal. Steady is. Divide the total time by the number of items and hold that average. One slow item means very little. The trend across ten of them means a lot. How to plan a pile, and how Daybearing's batch mode keeps the tally: https:// daybearing.com/blog/2026/10/ba tching-tasks/?utm_source=mastodon # timemanagement # Productivity # iOSApps # indiedev # DeepWork
